entries.title: Fail clean on Anthropic API errors; reconcile ROADMAP.md through Slice 26
entries.detail:
analystos/l2/analyze.py: analyze_document now catches
anthropic.APIError (the common base for every SDK-raised failure - a
hit spend limit, a bad/revoked key, a rate limit, an outage) around
the one API call and re-raises as a clean ValueError, never echoing
the raw exception. Without this, any of those failures would have
passed through api/analyze.py's ValueError-only except block
uncaught, surfacing as a raw, unhandled 500 instead of the same clean
{"error": "..."} shape every other pipeline failure already gets.
Prompted directly by setting up a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and a
monthly spend cap - hitting that cap needed to fail the same honest
way as everything else.

Tests added at both layers (analyze_document directly, and through
the Flask route) using a real anthropic.APIConnectionError raised
from a mocked client - still no real API call, no cost.

ROADMAP.md: reconciled through Slice 26 - it previously stopped at
Slice 24. Adds Slice 25 (universal upload) and Slice 26 (narrated
analysis) under a new "Beyond the original MVP" heading, since both
went past what the tracked phase originally scoped.
